MLBB server, region and ID: how to find and change them

Your ID and server are on your profile, and the account server never changes. The leaderboard region changes once a season, and on Android to any city.

In this story

  1. How to find your ID and server
  2. Can you change your server
  3. How to change the region on the leaderboard
  4. How to set another city on Android
  5. What about iPhone?
  6. How to get into your city's top
All news
In this story
How to find your ID and serverCan you change your serverHow to change the region on the leaderboardHow to set another city on AndroidWhat about iPhone?How to get into your city's top

In brief

  • Your ID and server are on your profile: the first number is the ID, the number in brackets is the server. For example, 123456789 (1234).
  • You cannot change your account's server: MOONTON does not move accounts between servers.
  • The leaderboard region is your phone's GPS location. It changes once per season, and on Android another city is set with a mock location app.

How to find your ID and server

  1. On the main screen, tap your avatar in the top left corner.
  2. Under your name there is the ID line: the long number is your ID, the number in brackets is the server.
  3. Copy it with the button next to it, so you do not mistype a digit.

For top-ups

Diamond shops ask for the ID and the server in two separate fields. If diamonds did not arrive, the number in brackets is almost always wrong. Before paying, check the name the shop shows.

Can you change your server

No. The server is fixed when the account is created, and the game has no transfer button. Advice like "turn on a VPN and the number will change" only works for a new account, and progress, skins and diamonds do not carry over. If you are looking for how to change your region in a hero's top, that is something else, and it can be done. See below.

How to change the region on the leaderboard

A hero leaderboard is split into the whole world, the country, the city, the district and a separate tab for your server. The game takes the city and district from your phone's location and changes them only when you tell it to.

  1. Turn on location services and allow them for Mobile Legends.
  2. Open the leaderboard and pick the hero.
  3. Tap the pin icon in the top right corner: a map opens.
  4. The game finds you by GPS and asks whether to change the place. Check the address and tap OK.
  5. Play one match with this hero to appear in the new district's leaderboard.

Once a season

You can change the place only once per season, so pick the city in advance. Older guides say once every seven days, but the 2026 client has a different rule.

How to set another city on Android

The game looks at GPS, not at the IP address, so a VPN will not change the city. On Android a mock location app sets the point you need.

  1. Install a mock location app from Google Play, for example Fake GPS Location.
  2. Turn on developer mode: Settings → About phone → tap Build number seven times. On Xiaomi it is OS version, on Samsung Software information → Build number.
  3. In Developer options, open Select mock location app and choose the app you installed.
  4. In the app, put the point in the city you want and start it.
  5. Close Mobile Legends completely and open it again.
  6. Leaderboard → pin icon: the new city should appear on the map. Confirm with OK.
  7. Play a match with the hero and only then turn the mock location off.

If the game sees the old city

Turn off improved accuracy by Wi‑Fi and mobile network in the location settings so coordinates come only from GPS, and check that the right app is selected in developer mode.

Risk

Faking the location bends the game rules, and MOONTON may penalise third-party tools. We found no reports of mass bans for changing the location, but there are no guarantees.

What about iPhone?

The App Store has no such apps. Coordinates can only be set from a computer: you connect the iPhone with a cable, and a program like 3uTools with its virtual location feature sets the point. The risk is the same. The way without programs is to change the place when you are actually in another city.

How to get into your city's top

Your place in the table depends on the hero's power, and power grows with ranked wins on that hero. Once a week the game counts the results and gives titles to the best in a district, a region and a country. The title shows on your profile and on the match loading screen; the highest one goes to the top ten in a country.

  • At the bottom of the table the game shows the approximate score needed to be ranked. While your power is below it, you cannot get in.
  • The fewer people play your hero in a city, the lower that threshold. A small city is usually easier than a capital.
  • Raise your power first, then change the place: a second change in one season will not work.
  • A title lasts a week; next week you have to defend it.

Frequently asked questions

How do I find my server in Mobile Legends?

Tap your avatar in the top left corner of the main screen. Under your name there is the ID line, and the number in brackets is the server.

Can I change my server in MLBB?

Not for an existing account. Another server means a new account without your old progress.

How do I change the region on the leaderboard?

Leaderboard → the pin icon in the top right → map → OK. For another city on Android you need a mock location app.

How often can I change the location?

Once per season. After the change, play a match with the hero.

Will a VPN help?

No. The leaderboard takes the place from the phone's GPS, not from the IP address.

We raise hero power for the top

Check the price of a boost on your hero in the calculator: it depends on rank and stars.
